brief.goal: Launch a habit-tracking mobile app aimed at people who have tried and abandoned other trackers
brief.audience: Adults 22-40 who have downloaded a habit or fitness app before and stopped using it within a month
keyMessages: One habit at a time, not twelve competing streaks
A missed day does not reset your progress to zero
Reminders that adapt to when you actually follow through, not a fixed time
proofPoints: average user is still active after 90 days, versus 12 days for the category

outline.title: Build one habit that actually sticks

scenes.beat: The graveyard of abandoned streak apps on your phone
Twelve habits at once is why none of them stick
One habit, forgiving of a missed day, reminders that learn
Download and start your one habit today
